editorial.blurb: Autea Sweets & Eats is a beloved neighborhood spot where handmade Asian desserts and thoughtful Chinese dishes come together in a welcoming, chill atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the combo deal: crispy rice pot paired with their tasty rice wine drink for $16.99—surprisingly great value and a chance to discover their underrated savory side beyond the famous desserts.
signatureDishes: Rice balls and taro balls with milk tea base
